form_title: Financial Campaign Report for County and Local School Board Candidates

reports.notes: Born-digital typed form (v. 4.20). Every summary figure is written as a whole dollar amount with no cents ('$0', '$200') - transcribed verbatim with the leading $ dropped, not padded to 200.00. DISAGREES WITH index.csv reporting_period: index.csv says 'Withdraw/Elimination', but the page face has the '30 Days after the General Election' radio filled and no other. Office is printed lower-case 'seat C' - transcribed as written. The candidate's signature is redacted upstream by the county (black bar spanning the signature block); the address, phone and email survive. This form prints no political-party field. Page 2 is Schedule A - Itemized Contributions Received (a single line, 4/2/20 self-contribution of $200), NOT a second cover page, so this is ONE report despite the locator flagging pages 1 and 2 as covers.
